proof_body:
by
  intro N _ a k
  constructor
  · simp [ZMod.dft_apply]
  · simp only [ZMod.dft_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have e : ∀ j : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (-(j * k)) = ZMod.stdAddChar (j * (-k)) := by
      intro j; congr 1; ring
    simp only [e]
    rw [AddChar.sum_mulShift (-k) (ZMod.isPrimitive_stdAddChar N)]
    simp [ZMod.card]
target_source: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a k : ZMod N), ZMod.dft (fun j => if j = a then (1 : ℂ) else 0) k = ZMod.stdAddChar (-(a * k)) ∧ ZMod.dft (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) k = if k = 0 then (N : ℂ) else 0
